pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with predominantly smooth-to-sub-angular edge gradients. Patch area is largest on the neck and cranial flank, transitioning to smaller geometries ventrally.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured mane along the dorsal neck ridge showing low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several fine linear textural disruptions and dark streaks are visible on the mid-to-posterior flank patches, consistent with superficial scarring.
